references.text: The people also reaffirm their commitment to serve the Lord here and reject the idea of abandoning him.
The people repeat their promise to serve the Lord and obey his voice, confirming their response in verse 21.
The people of Israel answer unanimously that they will do all that the Lord has said, a covenant pledge similar to Joshua 24.
The people respond with one voice that they will do all that the Lord has commanded, paralleling their commitment in Joshua.
The command to fear the Lord and serve him alone is the foundation of the people's confession to serve the Lord.
Moses commands the people to fear the Lord, serve him, and hold fast to him, which is the core of the people's pledge.
